# Icon sources

The bundled Apple, Bitcoin, Ethereum, NVIDIA, Tesla, Solana, Binance, Tether,
Dogecoin, Cardano, Litecoin and Ripple SVG marks come from
[Simple Icons 16.0.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/16.0.0/icons).
They are distributed under [CC0 1.0](SimpleIcons/LICENSE.md). The upstream SVG
geometry is retained; the app applies contrast-aware display colors.

The Microsoft four-square mark is drawn from four colored rectangles. Brand
names and marks belong to their respective owners. SF Symbols are supplied by
iOS. The Muyar app icon is drawn by `scripts/generate-icon.swift`.
